full_text:
Helinx is a demonic, cat-like Yama-Titan that bears blue armor. Its body is covered by a number of bony spikes. This Titan is used by Marduk.

History

Helinx was invoked by Marduk in Nostradamus' Tomb to ambush Dante Vale by pouncing upon him. Helinx then fought against Den Fears' Dullahan but was eventually defeated by Elf King Oberon. [Words from Eathon]

Abilities

Despite being just the size of a house pet, Helinx makes up for its size in its great agility, being capable of attacking swiftly and without notice. It is also very fierce and courageous, willing to attack Titans far larger than itself.
